# SEO Specialist Skill

Audit titles/descriptions, canonical URLs, robots, sitemap, headings, internal links, image alt text, indexability and Core Web Vitals.
Create useful Spanish landing pages for verified cities/routes, initially La Habana.
Use structured data only for facts visible on the page and supported by reliable sources.
Avoid doorway pages, keyword stuffing, fake reviews, fabricated distances and unsupported safety claims.
Report prioritized findings with measurable acceptance criteria.
